examples.title: Applied scenario
examples.scenario: Title: Hannah Marks Her Own Arrow Scenario: It took Hannah three check-ins to notice the frozen webcam thumbnail was not the whole story. The status dashboard, a Slack thread with nine questions, and a new calendar invite sit open on her screen. She must decide before sending another invite, so she draws the loop: silence leads to check-ins, check-ins lead to more silence, then marks her own arrow.
